'''Stephen Agnew''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Origins Open]] on 15 July 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base-numbers]], according to Bill Gordon's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1016">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-3rd-place-origins-opend1016/ 3rd-place-origins-open], DeckTech (Bill "BRay" Gordon, 17 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-17-3rd-place-origins-opend1016/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
